visual_brief.subject: GitGuardian reports 24,008 secrets in public agent-tool configurations
verified_context: GitGuardian reports 24,008 unique secrets in MCP-related configuration files on public GitHub.
Its report write-up says 2,117 unique credentials were found valid at the time; current validity and misuse are unverified.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A credential placed in shared configuration can become exposed; do not imply a specific breach or current live key.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: One unmarked brass key protrudes from an open seam in blank paper folders supported by pale stone. A material metaphor for an exposed credential, no computer interface or actual secret.
must_show: central focal forms that survive cover cropping

candidate_notes.A: Viable paper/key metaphor; the flat key overlaps the pale stack and reads less clearly at small size.
candidate_notes.B: Viable overhead reveal; central key is clear, but tighter framing reduces the spacious architectural feel.
candidate_notes.C: Selected: protruding key and folder seam remain separated at small scale; stone cradle anchors the wordless exposure metaphor.

crop_review.article_desktop: 1200 x 514 centered 21:9 crop inspected; focal relationship remains readable.
crop_review.article_mobile: 359 x 202 centered 16:9 crop inspected; primary forms remain visible.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 x 164 centered cover crop inspected; central silhouette remains distinct.
crop_review.home_square: 260 x 260 centered square preview inspected; nonessential edges crop, focal relationship survives.

golden_reference_comparison: Shares the archive warm architectural materiality, brass detail and deliberate geometry. It uses fewer forms and more photographic paper than the references; golden fit 87. The exposed key remains an abstract credential metaphor, not evidence of an actual breach.
contact_sheet_renderer: Pillow fallback with two golden references above three candidates. Canonical contact-sheet CLI was attempted but could not launch its missing Playwright Chromium; official browser download returned a truncated/non-ZIP payload. No repository code was changed to bypass this.

generation_metadata.review_type: Codex model visual self-review; no human sign-off
